e.summary_en: An insurance-theme contextual embedding benchmark built on an EIOPA official document: 60 documents and 120 queries
e.summary_hk: 基於 EIOPA 官方文檔的保險主題上下文嵌入基準：60 篇文檔 / 120 條查詢
e.body: ConTEB · Insurance（illuin-conteb，HuggingFace，2025-02-02 创建 / 2025-05-30 更新，246 次下载）是 **ConTEB（Context-aware Text Embedding Benchmark，上下文感知文本嵌入基准）** 的保险主题子集，用于**评估上下文嵌入模型在保险文本上的检索能力**。其底料是 **EIOPA（欧洲保险与职业养老金管理局）的一份官方文件**，规模为 **60 篇文档 / 120 条查询**（含 documents 与 queries 两个 config，parquet 格式）。对 RIAA：做保险 RAG（条款问答、监管文件检索、产品资料助手）时最实际的问题是「**通用嵌入模型在保险术语与监管文本上到底行不行**」——这个基准就是回答该问题的工具，而且它**以监管机构官方文件为底料**，检索难度贴近真实场景（长文档、术语密集、法律措辞）。池内 RAG 侧已有 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]（保险问答语料）、[[rag-insurance]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]（监管检索 MCP），ConTEB 补的是「**评估**」这一环：与 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]（可靠性）、[[ins-mmbench]] 与 [[ins-actbench]]（专业能力）并列，构成「**能力 / 可靠性 / 检索**」三类评测的第三类；其监管文本来源与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] 同属 EIOPA 体系。注意：数据集规模小（60/120），适合做嵌入模型的**对比选型**而非训练。
e.body_en: ConTEB · Insurance (illuin-conteb, HuggingFace, created 2025-02-02 / updated 2025-05-30, 246 downloads) is the insurance subset of **ConTEB (Context-aware Text Embedding Benchmark)**, designed to **evaluate contextual embedding models on insurance text retrieval**. Its source material is **an official EIOPA (European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority) document**, at a scale of **60 documents and 120 queries** (two configs, documents and queries, in parquet). For RIAA: the most practical question when building insurance RAG (clause Q&A, regulatory document search, product-material assistants) is "**do general embedding models actually work on insurance terminology and regulatory text**" — this benchmark answers it, and because it is **grounded in an official supervisory document**, its retrieval difficulty is close to real conditions (long documents, dense terminology, legal phrasing). The corpus’s RAG side already holds [[insuranceqa-corpus]] (insurance Q&A corpus), [[rag-insurance]], [[mongodb-rag-insurance]], [[valact-rag]] and [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] (a regulatory retrieval MCP); ConTEB supplies the "**evaluation**" stage: alongside [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] (reliability) and [[ins-mmbench]] / [[ins-actbench]] (professional capability), it forms the third of three evaluation classes — **capability / reliability / retrieval**; its regulatory source shares the EIOPA family with [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]. Note: the dataset is small (60/120), suited to **comparative model selection** for embeddings rather than training.
e.body_hk: ConTEB · Insurance（illuin-conteb，HuggingFace，2025-02-02 創建 / 2025-05-30 更新，246 次下載）是 **ConTEB（Context-aware Text Embedding Benchmark）** 的保險主題子集，用於**評估上下文嵌入模型在保險文本上的檢索能力**。其底料是 **EIOPA（歐洲保險與職業養老金管理局）的一份官方文件**，規模為 **60 篇文檔 / 120 條查詢**。對 RIAA：做保險 RAG（條款問答、監管文件檢索、產品資料助手）時最實際的問題是「**通用嵌入模型在保險術語與監管文本上到底行不行**」——這個基準就是回答該問題的工具，而且它**以監管機構官方文件為底料**，檢索難度貼近真實場景。池內 RAG 側已有 [[insuranceqa-corpus]]、[[rag-insurance]]、[[mongodb-rag-insurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]，ConTEB 補的是「**評估**」這一環：與 [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[ins-mmbench]]、[[ins-actbench]] 並列，構成「**能力 / 可靠性 / 檢索**」三類評測的第三類。注意：數據集規模小（60/120），適合做嵌入模型的**對比選型**而非訓練。
